notes: Dropout is applied to each sub-layer output before the residual add and to the embeddings plus positional encodings, as Section 5.4 describes.
The paper shares weights between the two embedding layers and the final linear layer; this code keeps them separate for readability.
Padding masks for variable-length batches are omitted; only the decoder's causal mask is built.
Vocabulary size 37000 matches the shared byte-pair vocabulary used for English-German.
